title: VP9 extension for armeabi-v7a fails
body:
Hello,

I am trying to build VP9 extension, but `libvpx` fails on `armeabi-v7a`. I am on Debian/sid with `android-ndk-r13b-linux-x86_64.zip`. I came across #1148 , which suggested that there could be issue with running 64b version of NDK. I have installed Debian stable 32b and digg `android-ndk-r10e-linux-x86.bin` from the Internet. The result is the same.
